title: Office hours, address, parking, holidays
goal: Find out the office hours, the address, and where to park.
try: Ask whether they are open on Thanksgiving.
Ask them to spell the street name.
Later in the call, ask about the hours again in different words ("so what time do you close on Fridays?") and notice if the answer changes.
Ask if there is more than one location.
expected: Gives consistent hours and address throughout; admits uncertainty instead of guessing on holidays/parking if it doesn't know.
pass_outcome: The patient leaves with one consistent set of hours and one address they could drive to.

checks.fail_if: Gives different hours when asked a second time in different words
Spells the street name differently from how it said it, or gives two addresses for one location
States holiday hours or parking details with confidence it has no basis for
